Syntax: search
              |
              |        Search the area carefully for hidden objects using your
              |        Search skill. Higher skill levels increase your chance
              |        of finding well-hidden items.
              |
              |        Some items are deliberately concealed and require searching
              |        to discover. Magical items like scrolls of detection or
              |        wands of seeking can also help reveal hidden things.
              |
              |        Related: detect hidden, hide, reveal
              |
